description: List every version ever published of one jurisdiction's rule, with its effective dates, values, citation and whether it is current, superseded or withdrawn. Example: `{"rule_type": "minimum_wage", "jurisdiction": "us-wa"}`. Covers that jurisdiction's own rule only; other levels that apply (e.g. `us`) are separate calls. Each entry's `id` can be passed to resolve_version. `page_url` is the rule's juriset.dev page for people, with the same history. Informational only, not legal advice.

domain.description: The rule type's domain, e.g. `employment`. Optional: when omitted it is looked up from the rule type.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction slug from list_jurisdictions, e.g. `us-wa` (Washington), `us` (US federal), `ca-ab` (Alberta).

rule_type.description: Rule type slug from list_rule_types, e.g. `minimum_wage`, `overtime`.

name: get_rule_history
title: Get a rule's version history
